posts.title: My Audience
posts.description: I think it's Stephen King, in "On Writing", that talks about the need to have an audience in mind when writing. He calls his Constant Reader, and when he writes, that is who he's writing to. He doesn't write for his millions of fans or just generally to the world. He sits down and writes his pages, and Constant Reader is who he is writing to. I've always kind of wanted to be a writer. But I didn't
